steps.label: 3001-own-paper1094-modify-open
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1094')throw Error('Own paper only');const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].filter(e=>{const u=new URL(e.getAttribute('href'),location.origin);return u.pathname==='/paper/modify.donga'&&u.searchParams.get('paperId')==='1094';});if(a.length!==1||a[0].classList.contains('disabled'))throw Error('Expected modify action');const href=a[0].getAttribute('href');a[0].click();return {href};})()
